name: Printing Press
description: Expose Printing Press CLI tools as OpenClaw tools — no shell access required

clis.description: List of Printing Press CLIs to expose as tools

binaryPath.description: Absolute path to the CLI binary

manifestPath.description: Path to tools-manifest.json (optional — uses CLI introspection if omitted)

allowedTools.description: Whitelist of tool names to register (registers all tools if omitted)

blockedMethods.description: HTTP methods to block for manifest mode (default: DELETE, PUT, PATCH)

blockedCommands.description: Additional commands to skip in introspection mode

maxTools.description: Maximum number of tools to register per CLI (default: 50)
